note: The original 2025 baseline results were already seen. This is not preregistration or an untouched final test.
target: operator-reported quarterly PUE; not electricity, water or resource stress
test_weather: Only county climate from years before the target year is used, never realized target-year weather.
availability_assumption: Historical hindcast assumes preceding-year PUE is available at the nominal origin. Actual publication timestamps and reporting delays are not reconstructed.
spatial_holdout: Remove all PUE observations from the test county, including both Loudoun campus labels, before fitting.
uncertainty: Paired county-cluster bootstrap of mean absolute error differences; 2000 draws, seed 20261010. Seven counties are too few for broad population inference.
claim_gate: No model superiority, AI-only impact or future stress claim from this exploratory pilot alone.
